description: A BattleBall game end to end on Barebones Classic (map 5, no power ups): STARTGAME (GAMELOCATION, the tickets, GAMEINSTANCE to an observer), entering the arena (ROOM_DIRECTORY -1 at the spawn, HEIGHTMAP and FULLGAMESTATUS, nothing on G_STAT), GAMESTATUS every 500 ms, no moves before GAMESTART, the lobby's visitors in the navigator, moves colouring tiles (GAMEEVENT 2), chat and typing in the arena, a power up nobody holds, GAMEEND with the scores, the finished game for the observer, history and statistics saved, back to the lobby (GAMEDELETED), the finished game in INSTANCELIST and OBSERVEINSTANCE, and the points in GAMEPLAYERINFO
